help.data.android: Chrome: Settings, then Site settings, then All sites. Find this site and press Clear data.
help.data.desktop: Chrome and Edge: click the icon to the left of the address bar, then Site settings, then press Clear data.
help.data.intro: Session records and language settings may remain in this device's browser storage. You can clear them in the browser's site settings.
help.data.ios: Safari: Settings, then Safari, then Advanced, then Website data. Find this site and delete it.
help.data.title: Clear saved data
help.intro: If you have found it hard to stop while playing, you do not have to bear it alone. There is somewhere to talk.

help.line.title: Counseling phone
help.remove.android: Android (Chrome): Long-press the icon on the home screen or in the app list. Choose Uninstall or App info, then press Delete.
help.remove.desktop: Desktop Chrome and Edge: Open the menu at the top right of the installed app window and choose Uninstall.
help.remove.intro: If you installed this site as an app, you can remove it in the following ways.
help.remove.ios: iPhone and iPad: Long-press the icon on the home screen, choose Remove App, then press Delete from Home Screen.
help.remove.title: Remove the installed app
